title: Serendipity Mat in Tube
body_html:
Launching Wednesday, November 25 at 10:00am CST.

Fresh, cheerful, and full of charm, the Serendipity Mat brings a bright sense of joy to your mahjong table. Soft pastels meet vibrant citrus-inspired hues to create a design that feels lighthearted, elegant, and effortlessly playful.

A refreshing palette of sky blue, blush pink, and sunny chartreuse sets the tone, while delicate florals and graceful ginkgo leaves add movement and whimsy throughout the design. Art Deco-inspired details and geometric accents provide a touch of structure, creating a beautiful balance between classic sophistication and modern style.

Whether paired with colorful tile sets or used as a statement piece on its own, the Serendipity Mat adds a bright, uplifting energy to every game.

Why You'll Love It

• Bright floral design featuring delicate blooms and graceful ginkgo leaves
• Soft pastel palette accented with vibrant chartreuse for a fresh, cheerful look
• Art Deco-inspired details add timeless elegance
• Instructional layout printed directly on the mat for easy gameplay
• Smooth neoprene surface helps keep tiles in place
• Stitched border for a polished, durable finish

Details

• Mat Dimensions: 33" x 33"
• Material: Neoprene with stitched border

Storage

• Comes rolled in a reusable, sleek storage tube
• Tube Dimensions: 33.5" long x 2 3/4" wide
• Perfect for stylish storage and effortless travel
